monotonicity.argument: Original labels are processed first. A later label replaces only on strictly larger capped count. Then the old count is below7 and the new exact count is larger. Ties leave the original label unchanged.
monotonicity.conclusion: Number of zero candidate scan masks never decreases for any original classical masks.

scope: Selector and pointwise scan-cost certificate only. Whole-decoder phase/correctness and score require verification after splicing.
